name: Extra Tactics
body:
You can use your battle tactics more often than normal.

Prerequisite: Battle tactics class feature.

Benefit: You can use your battle tactics an additional for 6 additional rounds per day.

Special: You can gain Extra Tactics multiple times. Its effects stack.
